pred_ddx.label: Severe COVID-19 Pneumonia with Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS)

Severe COVID-19 Pneumonia with Acute Res: The patient has a confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection, bilateral ground-glass opacities on chest CT, and worsening respiratory status requiring intubation, all of which are consistent with severe COVID-19 pneumonia and ARDS. The patient's hypoxemia and the need for pressure-control ventilation also support this diagnosis.
Ventilator-Associated Pneumonia (VAP): The patient developed a new infection while intubated, as evidenced by the initiation of cefepime on ICU day 3, which is consistent with ventilator-associated pneumonia. The patient's elevated WBC and CRP also support the presence of a secondary infection.

The patient developed a new onset of infection (as evidenced by the start of cefepime) while being mechanically ventilated, which is consistent with VAP. The patient's elevated WBC count (13,900/µL) and CRP (13.1 mg/dL) also suggest an infectious process.
